goal: Define BodyState(t)+EnvironmentState(t) -> RelativeGeometry(t) -> visual/looming variables -> Sensory Encoder -> Neural Input(t+1)

virtual_sensor_extrinsics_v0.note: co-located/aligned engineering visual sensor; not a biological compound-eye model

object_contract.visibility: bool; environment-level visibility only, not FOV/occlusion inference

environment_state.invalid_policy: Malformed required frame/object field, duplicate object_id, nonfinite value, or radius<=0 rejects the whole EnvironmentState frame. Empty object array is valid blank scene.

relative_geometry.synchronization: BodyState(t) and EnvironmentState(t) must refer to the same model timestamp; deterministic interpolation to t is allowed only when its method is versioned. No future-state lookahead.

derived_fields.left_right_relation: LEFT if azimuth>1e-6 rad; RIGHT if azimuth<-1e-6 rad; otherwise CENTER
derived_fields.approach_recession: APPROACHING if range_rate<-1e-6 m/s; RECEDING if >1e-6 m/s; otherwise STATIONARY

relative_geometry.unsupported_geometry: If distance_m<=radius_m, mark object geometry INVALID_OVERLAP and do not fabricate angular size/expansion. Other valid objects in the same frame remain usable.
relative_geometry.fov_policy: NOT_MODELED_IN_GEOMETRY_LAYER; Sensory Encoder may apply a versioned FOV later
relative_geometry.aggregation_policy: NO_OBJECT_SELECTION_OR_POOLING_IN_FEEDBACK_CONTRACT; emit one geometry record per valid object

fields.target_neural_timestep_id: next neural timestep receiving encoded input

feedback_frame.latency: VIRTUAL_CLOSED_LOOP_V0 uses exactly one model-step causal latency: state at t -> geometry at t -> encoded neural input applied at t+dt

REPLAY.rule: Recorded/replayed sensory input is authoritative; BodyState is ignored by sensory generation. REPLAY != CLOSED_LOOP.

VIRTUAL_CLOSED_LOOP.rule: BodyState(t)+EnvironmentState(t) deterministically generate relative geometry and next neural input.

REAL_SENSOR_INTERACTION.rule: A real camera/sensor alone is not sufficient. Closure requires the system output/body/viewpoint to causally change the subsequent physical sensor measurement.

sensory_encoder_boundary.output_rule: Encoder produces Neural Input for target neural timestep; numerical sensory encoding remains a separate contract and is not redefined here.

invalid_handling.invalid_BodyState: No FeedbackFrame produced; downstream treats as no valid new sensory observation.
invalid_handling.invalid_single_object_overlap: Object marked INVALID_OVERLAP and excluded from Sensory Encoder; frame remains valid if other objects are valid.
invalid_handling.timestamp_mismatch: Reject feedback composition unless deterministic versioned interpolation aligns both sources to the same model time.
invalid_handling.nan_inf: Reject affected source frame; never coerce.
